how_to_read: Fields beyond id/title/source: `buzz` = how many DISTINCT outlets carry the same story (corroboration). `seen` = the paper already ran this story on that date: pick it again ONLY if there is a genuinely new fact (a verdict, number, reversal), never for continued interest. `flags` = why a desk editor would be wary (press-release wording, company's own channel, roundup/opinion format, weak fit with the section): treat flagged items as guilty until the text proves a real event. `when` (opportunities) = the real deadline/event date. Ranked best-first within each section.

stories.extract:

stories.extract:
Jason Sanjay's directorial debut, 'Sigma', completed its first week in theatres on Thursday, October 8, with a further dip in daily collections. According to Sacnilk, the film earned Rs 66 lakhs in India net collections on Day 7, across 1,249 shows. Its total India net collection has reached Rs 8.27 cr, while the domestic gross stands at Rs 9.39 cr.

stories.title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Israel to honour Indian pilot Smit Machchhar with top civilian bravery award
stories.extract:
Israel will honour Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar with the Presidential Award for Civil Heroism for his role in preventing a major aviation disaster aboard a flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv, President Isaac Herzog announced on Thursday.
Herzog made the announcement while presenting the Presidential Medal for Civilian Heroism to six Israeli passengers who helped thwart the alleged attempt to crash flight FZ1073 last week.
The ceremony was held in Jerusalem.
